request.system:
You write a short brief for an account owner in Sales at Lumen Labs. A signal has fired on one of their accounts, and they will decide whether and how to reach out. They have two minutes and have not looked at this account recently.

You are given a JSON object of facts about the account. Use only those facts. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as given: do not round, add, subtract, estimate or convert. If a fact is missing or null, leave it out. Do not guess at reasons the data does not show.

Write five short lines, in this order, each starting with its label:

Signal: what fired, in plain words.
Evidence: the two or three facts that matter most for this signal.
Likely need: what the customer probably needs (more seats, or the next edition), and why the evidence points there.
Suggested opener: one sentence the account owner could say or write to the customer. Helpful, not pushy.
Risks: anything in the facts that argues for caution (open high-priority tickets, a low NPS score, yellow or red health, a renewal close by). Write "none visible in the data" if there is nothing.

Plain text, no headings, no bullet symbols.

messages.content: {"account_name": "Doveth Clinics", "segment": "smb", "edition": "free", "next_edition": "standard", "arr": 0, "seats_licensed": 10, "seats_assigned": 8, "seats_assigned_30_days_ago": 7, "seat_utilisation_pct": 80, "monthly_active_users": 5, "automation_rules": 2, "automation_rule_limit": 5, "integrations": 1, "integration_limit": 2, "assist_credits_used_30d": 0, "assist_credits_included": 0, "health_score": 86.9, "health_band": "green", "open_high_priority_tickets": 0, "latest_nps_score": 9, "days_to_renewal": 312, "trigger_signal": "expansion_ready", "trigger_evidence": "Expansion likelihood 41%: nearly all seats assigned, reads our emails, free edition", "expansion_score_pct": 41, "expansion_reasons": "nearly all seats assigned, reads our emails, free edition"}

content.text:
Signal: Doveth Clinics is flagged as expansion-ready, with an expansion likelihood of 41% on a free edition.
Evidence: 8 of 10 licensed seats are assigned, up from 7 thirty days ago, and seat utilisation is 80%. Health score is 86.9 (green) and latest NPS is 9. Automation rules are at 2 of 5 and integrations at 1 of 2.
Likely need: The account is close to using all its seats and is growing, so the likely need is more seats, with the Standard edition as the next step if they want more of the automation and integration headroom they have not yet used. The data does not show what is driving the growth, so confirm that with the customer.
Suggested opener: "Doveth's team has grown from 7 to 8 seats in the last month, and you have two seats left, so I wanted to check whether you need more room before you hit the limit."
Risks: Monthly active users are 5 of 8 assigned seats, so not all assigned seats are in regular use. ARR is 0 and renewal is 312 days away, so there is no current contract value to protect. No open high-priority tickets.
